title: Remove the raw full-inventory review identity (review_identity*.rs, termal_review_identity tool and API); review uses only the shared source_id
outcome: TermAl has one review-input identity: the shared source_id produced by `engram source`, with Git commit and diff ranges selecting the reviewed content. The raw review identity, which lists the whole index (`git ls-files --stage --sparse --debug -z` in review_identity_inventory.rs) and walks directories, is removed from the product. That covers its modules, the termal_review_identity MCP tool, its HTTP API and its documentation, so nothing can call it, not even as an opt-in.
acceptance: The raw review identity capture is deleted: src/review_identity.rs, review_identity_api.rs, review_identity_discovery.rs, review_identity_fs.rs, review_identity_git.rs, review_identity_inventory.rs and their routes, the termal_review_identity MCP tool, and the tests and docs that only exercise them. No caller remains, verified by a source search recorded on the item.

Every TermAl review, resume and delegation path that used the raw identity uses the shared source_id instead, with Git commit and diff ranges for content selection. No other identity, scan, inventory or environment check is introduced.
The review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
